description:
USE THIS TOOL WHEN identifying a committee inquiry or business before evidence retrieval.

Returns official business IDs, titles, types, dates, and report/status metadata.
AFTER calling, use an exact ID as committee_business_id in committees_search_evidence.
Source: UK Parliament Committees API CommitteeBusiness endpoint.

query.description: Optional official inquiry/business title search term. Returns source-supplied IDs; do not infer an ID from a title.

name: committees_search_businesses

businesses.description: Matching source-supplied committee businesses or inquiries

items.description: Source-supplied parliamentary committee business or inquiry identity.

id.description: Official CommitteeBusiness ID; use as committee_business_id for exact evidence filtering

is_inquiry.description: Source-supplied type flag; null when absent

latest_report.description: Source-supplied latest-report metadata, unmodified when present

type.description: Source-supplied business type name, e.g. Inquiry

committee_id.description: Committee ID used to scope the discovery request

query.description: Source search term applied, if any

total.description: Number of businesses returned in this page

title: Search Committee Inquiries and Business
